id: title:Gilbert09:add instana metrics apdex mobile app and synthetic location tables

review.posthog_relevance: Adds implementation and configuration for application-monitoring metrics ingestion from Instana, including row-pivoting, window alignment, pagination, and resumability, alongside supporting configuration and documentation.
review.reason: The chunk contains substantive implementation changes: P1.F3.H5 adds the main metric-fetching iterator, pagination, and resumability; P1.F3.H1 and P1.F3.H2 add configuration and resume state. P1.F1.H1 is documentation. P1.F7.H1 is tests. This represents a bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new metric ingestion and fan-out paths; P1.F3.H8, P1.F4, and P1.F5 are not supplied. The tier is assigned based on the visible implementation and configuration, not the complete end-to-end behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by documentation and configuration changes. P1.F1.H1 is a markdown file documenting API changes, not executable code. P1.F3.H1 and P1.F3.H2 are configuration and type changes. P1.F3.H3 and P1.F3.H4 show the actual implementation change: adding a `json_body` parameter and switching from GET to POST for metrics. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Documentation update: P1.F1.H1 adds markdown entries for previously unchecked API endpoints, including synthetic locations, datacenters, mobile apps, and application metrics.
